plan.description: Decompose complex multi-step user intents into an executable, dependency-aware plan.

precheck.description: Validate runtime prerequisites, environment variables, dependencies, and permissions.

capability-check.description: Match required tool operations against current model/harness capabilities.

permission-check.description: Assert least-privilege policies and determine if human authorization is mandated.

execute.description: Perform deterministic tool actions, code generation, refactoring, or builds.

observe.description: Capture stdout, stderr, process return codes, and diff outcomes from executions.

verify.description: Execute AST linters, unit tests, and schema validators to certify functional correctness.

repair.description: Perform targeted root-cause repairs upon detecting validation or test failures.

reverify.description: Run the complete verification battery after applying automated repairs.

report.description: Summarize accomplished work, changes made, evidence verified, and next steps.

audit.description: Examine codebases or configurations for compliance, security, and quality benchmarks.

scaffold.description: Initialize boilerplate, project templates, configuration files, and harnesses.

refactor.description: Restructure existing code without modifying external observable behavior.

benchmark.description: Measure latency, throughput, token efficiency, or execution characteristics.

document.description: Generate technical documentation, OpenAPI specs, architecture guides, and READMEs.

deploy.description: Push artifacts to staging or production environments under strict authorization gates.

rollback.description: Revert failed deployments, migrations, or code changes to last known good checkpoint.

sync.description: Reconcile local catalog, lockfile, and harness skills with upstream authoritative sources.
